# Upstream source

This crate is vendored from [`Ruraam/Bubbleos` `theme-engine`](https://github.com/Ruraam/Bubbleos/tree/tests/theme-engine), commit `779db228bdfc75262d8cb477c29b4faea8f7866a`.

The source project declares this package as MIT licensed. The local `rust-version` is set to 1.87 to match BubbleWM's workspace minimum; the engine implementation is otherwise kept aligned with the upstream branch.
